text: I think you'll enjoy this All-American Cowboy Salad recipe, as it features a blend of flavors and textures that you seem to appreciate in your liked recipes. The combination of ham, cheese, and ranch dressing is a familiar and comforting one, and the addition of fresh herbs like parsley and lettuce adds a nice brightness to the dish. The presence of dried oregano is also a plus, as you tend to like recipes that include this ingredient. This salad should take about 40 minutes to prepare, which is within your typical time budget.
